```{r}
load_dataset <- function(id){
  a <- fread(paste(id, ".tsv", sep=""))
  gene_names <- mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = as.character(a$GeneID),
    column = "SYMBOL", 
    keytype = "ENTREZID",
    multiVals = "first"
)
  a$GeneID <- gene_names
  colnames(a)[1] <- "Gene"
  a <- a[!duplicated(a$Gene),]
  a <- a[!is.na(a$Gene),]
  a <- as.data.frame(a)
  rownames(a) <- a$Gene
  a$Gene <- NULL
  return(a)
}

load_meta <- function(id){
  a  <- getGEO(id, GSEMatrix = TRUE)
  a  <- pData(a [[1]])
  return(a)
}

individual_DESeq2_female <- function(data,meta,col_index_nas, col_index_sex,name){
  meta <- meta[rownames(meta) %in% colnames(data),] #only get the samples where count data is availasble
  meta <- meta[meta[,col_index_sex] %in% c("Female","F","female"),] 
  colData <- as.data.frame(meta[,col_index_nas]) # create the design df
  rownames(colData) <- rownames(meta) 
  colnames(colData) <- "score" #name NAS as score
  colData <- colData[!colData[, 1] == "NA", , drop = FALSE]
    colData <- colData %>% mutate(
      score = as.integer(score),
      score = case_when(
    score %in% c(0,1,2) ~ 0,
    score %in% c(3) ~ 1,
    score %in% c(4) ~ 2,
    score %in% c(5) ~ 3,
    score %in% c(6,7,8) ~ 4,
    TRUE ~ score
  ))
  data <- data[,colnames(data) %in% rownames(colData)]
  print(sum(rownames(colData) != colnames(data))) # check whether rownames of colData is same with colnames of data !should return 0
  colData$score <- as.factor(colData$score) #factorize them
  if (all(c("0", "4") %in% unique(as.character(colData$score)))) {
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = data, colData = colData, design = ~ score) #classic DESeq2s
  dds <- DESeq(dds) 
  group_sizes <- table(colData$score)
  smallest_group_size <- min(group_sizes)
  keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= smallest_group_size
  dds <- dds[keep,]
  comb <- data.frame(A = c(0), B = c(4))
  print(comb)
  for (i in 1:nrow(comb)){
    res <- data.frame(DESeq2::results(dds, contrast = c("score",comb$B[i],comb$A[i]), cooksCutoff = FALSE))
      # Create folder path
  folder_path <- paste(name, "/gender/", sep = "")
  
  # Ensure directory exists
  if (!dir.exists(folder_path)) {
    dir.create(folder_path, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Construct filename and full path
  file_name <- paste("female_NAS_DESEQ2_", as.character(comb$B[i]), "_VS_", as.character(comb$A[i]), ".csv", sep = "")
  full_path <- paste(folder_path, file_name, sep = "")
  write.csv(res, full_path)
  }
  }else{
    print(name)
  }
}
  
individual_DESeq2_male <- function(data,meta,col_index_nas, col_index_sex,name){
  meta <- meta[rownames(meta) %in% colnames(data),] #only get the samples where count data is availasble
  meta <- meta[meta[,col_index_sex] %in% c("Male","M","male"),] 
  colData <- as.data.frame(meta[,col_index_nas]) # create the design df
  rownames(colData) <- rownames(meta) 
  colnames(colData) <- "score" #name NAS as score
  colData <- colData[!colData[, 1] == "NA", , drop = FALSE]
    colData <- colData %>% mutate(
      score = as.integer(score),
      score = case_when(
    score %in% c(0,1,2) ~ 0,
    score %in% c(3) ~ 1,
    score %in% c(4) ~ 2,
    score %in% c(5) ~ 3,
    score %in% c(6,7,8) ~ 4,
    TRUE ~ score
  ))
  data <- data[,colnames(data) %in% rownames(colData)]
  print(sum(rownames(colData) != colnames(data))) # check whether rownames of colData is same with colnames of data !should return 0
  colData$score <- as.factor(colData$score) #factorize them
  if (all(c("0", "4") %in% unique(as.character(colData$score)))) {
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = data, colData = colData, design = ~ score) #classic DESeq2s
  dds <- DESeq(dds) 
  group_sizes <- table(colData$score)
  smallest_group_size <- min(group_sizes)
  keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= smallest_group_size
  dds <- dds[keep,]
  comb <- data.frame(A = c(0), B = c(4))
  print(comb)
  for (i in 1:nrow(comb)){
    res <- data.frame(DESeq2::results(dds, contrast = c("score",comb$B[i],comb$A[i]), cooksCutoff = FALSE))
      # Create folder path
  folder_path <- paste(name, "/gender/", sep = "")
  
  # Ensure directory exists
  if (!dir.exists(folder_path)) {
    dir.create(folder_path, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Construct filename and full path
  file_name <- paste("male_NAS_DESEQ2_", as.character(comb$B[i]), "_VS_", as.character(comb$A[i]), ".csv", sep = "")
  full_path <- paste(folder_path, file_name, sep = "")
  write.csv(res, full_path)
  }
  }else{
    print(name)
  }
}
```

```{r}
GSE <- c("GSE193066","GSE130970","GSE192959","GSE207310","GSE162694","GSE174478","GSE185051")
index_nas <- c(46,47,42,47,45,43,46)
index_sex <- c(42,42,39,45,42,39,45)

#Female set problem in --> GSE192959
#Male set problem in --> GSE207310

for (i in 1:length(GSE)){
  data <- load_dataset(GSE[i])
  meta <- load_meta(GSE[i])
  individual_DESeq2_female(data,meta,index_nas[i], index_sex[i],GSE[i])
}

for (i in 1:length(GSE)){
  data <- load_dataset(GSE[i])
  meta <- load_meta(GSE[i])
  individual_DESeq2_male(data,meta,index_nas[i], index_sex[i],GSE[i])
}
```

```{r female}
GSE_female <- c("GSE130970","GSE207310","GSE162694","GSE174478","GSE185051")
#GSE193066 droped due to p val distrubtion
index_female <- c(47,47,45,43,46)
index_female_sex <- c(42,45,42,39,45)
studies <- list()
comb <- as.data.frame(t(combn(0:4, 2)))
colnames(comb) <- c("A", "B")
print(comb)

c <- 4

# Loop through each element in GSE
for (i in 1:length(GSE_female)) {
  # Construct the file path and read the CSV file
  file_path <- paste(GSE_female[i], "/gender/female_NAS_DESEQ2_",as.character(comb$B[c]),"_VS_",as.character(comb$A[c]),".csv", sep = "")
  studies[[i]] <- read.csv(file_path)
}
  common_rows <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(studies, function(df) df$X))
  # Filter each dataset to contain only common rows & sort them
  datasets_filtered <- lapply(studies, function(df) {
    df <- df[df$X %in% common_rows, ]  # Keep only common rows
    df <- df[order(df$X), ]  # Sort by column 'X'
    return(df)
  })
  
  
 # Create lists to store p-values, fold changes, and adjusted p-values
rawpval <- lapply(1:length(datasets_filtered), function(i) datasets_filtered[[i]][["pvalue"]])
FC <- lapply(1:length(datasets_filtered), function(i) datasets_filtered[[i]][["log2FoldChange"]])
adjpval <- lapply(1:length(datasets_filtered), function(i) datasets_filtered[[i]][["padj"]])

# List of study names
studies <- GSE_female

# Set up the layout for 2 rows and 5 columns
par(mfrow = c(2, 5), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1), oma = c(4, 4, 4, 4))

# Loop through all datasets
for (i in 1:length(datasets_filtered)) {
  # Plot histogram with transparency to avoid overlap
  hist(rawpval[[i]], breaks=100, col=rgb(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5), 
       main=paste(studies[i]), 
       xlab="Raw p-values", 
       cex.main=0.8,   # Reduce title size
       cex.lab=0.7,    # Reduce axis label size
       las=1)          # Ensure horizontal axis labels
}

mtext(paste("Raw p-values",as.character(comb$B[c]),"VS",as.character(comb$A[c]),sep=" "), side = 3, outer = TRUE, line = 1, cex = 1.5, font = 2)

# Apply DE calculation for each dataset
DE <- mapply(function(x) ifelse(x <= 0.05, 1, 0), adjpval)

# Set column names for DE
colnames(DE) <- paste("DE", studies, sep=".")

rep <- list()
for (i in 1:length(studies)){
  data <- load_dataset(studies[i])
  meta <- load_meta(studies[i])
  col_index <- index_female[i]
  meta <- meta[rownames(meta) %in% colnames(data),] #only get the samples where count data is availasble
  meta <- meta[meta[,index_female_sex[i]] %in% c("Female","F","female"),] 
  colData <- as.data.frame(meta[,col_index]) # create the design df
  rownames(colData) <- rownames(meta) 
  colnames(colData) <- "score" #name NAS as score
  colData <- colData[!colData[, 1] == "NA", , drop = FALSE]
    colData <- colData %>% mutate(
      score = as.integer(score),
      score = case_when(
    score %in% c(0,1,2) ~ 0,
    score %in% c(3) ~ 1,
    score %in% c(4) ~ 2,
    score %in% c(5) ~ 3,
    score %in% c(6,7,8) ~ 4,
    TRUE ~ score
  ))
  data <- data[,colnames(data) %in% rownames(colData)]
  print(sum(rownames(colData) != colnames(data))) # check whether rownames of colData is same with colnames of data !should return 0
  colData$score <- as.factor(colData$score) #factorize them
  sum(colData$score %in% c(comb$A[c],comb$B[c]))
  rep <- append(rep,sum(colData$score %in% c(comb$A[c],comb$B[c])))
}

invnormcomb <- invnorm(rawpval,nrep= as.vector(unlist(rep)), BHth = 0.05)
  
hist(invnormcomb$rawpval, breaks=100, col="grey",main="Inverse normal method",xlab = "Raw p-values (meta-analysis)")
 
fishcomb <- fishercomb(rawpval, BHth = 0.05)

hist(fishcomb$rawpval, breaks=100, col="grey", main="Fisher method",xlab = "Raw p-values (meta-analysis)")

 
DEresults <- data.frame(DE,"DE.fishercomb"=ifelse(fishcomb$adjpval<=0.05,1,0),"DE.invnorm"=ifelse(invnormcomb$adjpval<=0.05,1,0))


# Extract signs of fold changes
signsFC <- mapply(FC, FUN=function(x) sign(x))

# Sum signs across studies to identify consistent/contradictory genes
sumsigns <- apply(signsFC, 1, sum)
commonsgnFC <- ifelse(abs(sumsigns) == dim(signsFC)[2], sign(sumsigns), 0)

# Identify differentially expressed genes from meta-analysis
unionDE <- unique(c(fishcomb$DEindices, invnormcomb$DEindices))

# Create a table combining DE results, fold changes, and sign consistency
FC.selecDE <- data.frame(DEresults[unionDE, ], 
                         do.call(cbind, FC)[unionDE, ], 
                         signFC=commonsgnFC[unionDE])

# Filter out conflicting genes
keepDE <- FC.selecDE[which(abs(FC.selecDE$signFC) == 1), ]
conflictDE <- FC.selecDE[which(FC.selecDE$signFC == 0), ]

# Check the number of conflicting genes
cat("Total DE genes before filtering:", nrow(FC.selecDE), "\n")
cat("DE genes after removing conflicts:", nrow(keepDE), "\n")
cat("Conflicting genes removed:", nrow(conflictDE), "\n")

# Save the cleaned results
dim(keepDE)
dim(conflictDE)

ordered_gene_names <- common_rows[order(common_rows)]
existing_genes_keep <- ordered_gene_names[as.numeric(rownames(keepDE))]
rownames(keepDE) <- existing_genes_keep


# # Compute IDD and IRR for multiple studies
# fishcomb_de <- rownames(keepDE)[which(keepDE[,"DE.fishercomb"] == 1)]
# invnorm_de <- rownames(keepDE)[which(keepDE[,"DE.invnorm"] == 1)]

# # Dynamically collect DE gene names from all studies
# study_cols <- grep("DE.", colnames(keepDE), value = TRUE)
# indstudy_de <- lapply(study_cols, function(study) rownames(keepDE)[which(keepDE[[study]] == 1)])
# 
# # Calculate IDD and IRR
# cat("IDD and IRR for Fisher's method:\n")
# print(IDD.IRR(fishcomb_de, indstudy_de))
# 
# cat("IDD and IRR for Inverse Normal method:\n")
# print(IDD.IRR(invnorm_de, indstudy_de))

# upset_data <- as.data.frame(sapply(study_cols, function(study) as.integer(rownames(keepDE) %in% rownames(keepDE)[which(keepDE[[study]] == 1)])))
# colnames(upset_data) <- study_cols
# library(UpSetR)
# upset(upset_data, sets = study_cols, keep.order = TRUE, order.by = "freq")

keepDE$average_logFC <- rowMeans(keepDE[,(length(studies)+3):(2*length(studies)+2)])

colnames(keepDE)[(length(studies)+3):(2*length(studies)+2)] <- paste0(studies, "-FC")
keepDE$Gene <- rownames(keepDE)
df <- keepDE[, c(ncol(keepDE), 1:(ncol(keepDE) - 1))]
write_xlsx(df, paste("female_Individual_Analysis_",as.character(comb$B[c]),"_VS_",as.character(comb$A[c]),".xlsx", sep = ""))
```
